items.title: Cipher Digital Delivered Early, But Its Growth Waits On Texas
items.summary: The capacity already under contract arrived ahead of schedule, while the far larger pipeline behind it now waits on a Texas approval process with no date attached.

items.title: Who Really Benefits as Sovereign AI Infrastructure Spending Explodes?
items.summary: Governments are pouring billions into national AI compute capacity, and the race is minting winners across silicon, real estate, and power infrastructure. But the benefits are not spread evenly, and knowing which layer captures the biggest dollar share changes the investment calculus entirely.

items.title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on Digital Realty Trust Stock?
items.summary: Despite lagging the broader market over the past year, Digital Realty Trust continues to enjoy a favorable outlook on Wall Street.

items.title: IRM Q2 AFFO Beats Estimates on Data Center and ALM Growth, '26 View Up
items.summary: Iron Mountain tops Q2 estimates as data centers, ALM and digital growth fuel stronger results, prompting a higher 2026 AFFO outlook.

items.title: Public Storage Q2 FFO Misses on Same-Store NOI Decline, Revenues Beat
items.summary: PSA lags Q2 core FFO estimates, but higher revenues, acquisitions and a stronger 2026 outlook highlight how expansion is helping offset same-store pressure.

items.title: W.P. Carey's Q2 AFFO Beats Estimates on Investment Activity
items.summary: WPC tops Q2 AFFO estimates as investment activity and rent growth lift revenues. The company raises its 2026 AFFO guidance and investment outlook.

items.title: BXP Q2 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on Occupancy Gains, '26 View Up
items.summary: BXP tops Q2 FFO estimates as occupancy, leasing and NOI improve and raises its full-year 2026 FFO outlook on stronger-than-expected portfolio performance.

items.title: American Tower Q2 AFFO Meets Estimates, Revenues Beat, '26 View Up
items.summary: AMT's Q2 AFFO comes in line with estimates as revenues top expectations, fueled by tower leasing and data center growth. A higher 2026 outlook signals momentum.
